simple.summary: בֵּלְשַׁאצַּר (Bêlshaʼtstsar) means Belshatstsar , a Babylonian king First listed occurrence: Dan 8 1.

definitions.full: H1112. Beleshatstsar ֵבּלְאשַׁצַּר proper name, masculine ( Bêl-šar-uƒur , Bel, protect the king COT Dan 5:1 ) 8:1 ; represented as king of Babylon, successor, and apparently son of Nebuchadrezzar ( 5:1-2 , 11 etc.); in cuneiform inscription known only as prince, son of Nabonidus (last Shemitic king of Babylon), see COT 1.c.
definitions.rootNote: or בֵּלְאשַׁצַּר lemma בֵּלְאשַׁצּר missing vowel, corrected to בֵּלְאשַׁצַּר ; of foreign origin (compare 1095 );
